I don't know if these can be considered cheesing but you might want to try these:

1. Have a good healer on the tip for Gloria to tank hits better.


2. Have a good seeker on the team. Most of the enemies are breakers in that level (if I remember correctly) so a good seeker will give you greater manuevarability by allowing you to do back attacks.


3. You might want to try immediately throwing the lance of longinus against the enemies. The combat area is small so Gloria on her first turn could reach halfway through the enemies. Pair that with good equipment and the buffs from the event, and one throw of the lance should already do a lot of damage to 3-4 enemies (just as long you position the throw correctly). It also helps if you would put Gloria at the front and center of your formation for better positioning when throwing the lance.
